task: unchanged Panda Door Level2, Progress Reward, reset and controller

data.R: 484 formal_v1 valid successful corrections, exclude injection/policy prefixes and natural crosscheck
data.N: 484 normal reset successes using the same Phase14.1 expert, no injection
data.added_sampling: 256 S + 256 R/N per update, fixed total 10240000 examples per arm; A/B 512 S
data.split: whole trajectories, stratified by recovery type, 70/15/15 for added sources

normalization: frozen Phase13 train-S means/stds; replace constant target-angle slot with velocity train-S mean/std; all arms same; masks after normalization
checkpoint_selection: minimum common source-balanced validation MSE every 1000 updates, no evaluation success selection
primary: heldout random success, D-B/D-F/D-C/F-B paired seed differences; t95CI + exact signflip + Holm adjusted paired t

evaluation.reference_prefix: frozen Phase13 candidate, fresh test seeds, same recorded physical action prefixes for every learned policy
evaluation.natural: unperturbed reference rollout at tick169, EEF-handle 0.10-0.20m, no task success; fresh states, excluded from all training

stage_metrics.grasp_proxy: both contacts, distance<0.06m, action gripper<0, width 0.005-0.079m sustained3ticks; proxy not full force closure
stage_metrics.success: terminal angle>1rad; original 600-tick episode budget including prefix

anchor_gate: D better than B/F/C in all5 paired seeds with paired t95CI lower>0, random mean>0.80, artificial improvement over B, fixed no loss>5pp relative B, random seed SD<0.10; independent untouched test required
pose_boundary: fullGT assumes calibrated handle pose can be measured; hardware not demonstrated; D_no_handle additionally evaluated
